question: What is the value of 40 times ( (0.74 + 1.48)/(2frac{4){5} + 7(1)/(15)} ) ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Numerator: 0.74 + 1.48 = 2.22

Denominator: 2 4/5 = 2.8 and 7 1/15 ≈ 7.0667 ⇒ sum ≈ 9.8667

So expression ≈ 40 × (2.22 / 9.8667)

≈ 40 × 0.225 = 9

**∴ Answer = 9**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

40 × ( (0.74 + 1.48) ÷ (2 4/5 + 7 1/15) )

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS rule

**Calculation:**

⇒ 40 × ( (2.22) ÷ (2 4/5 + 7 1/15) )

⇒ 40 × ( 2.22 ÷ (14/5 + 106/15) )

⇒ 40 × ( 2.22 ÷ (42/15 + 106/15) )

⇒ 40 × ( 2.22 ÷ (148/15) )

⇒ 40 × ( 2.22 × 15 / 148 )

⇒ 40 × ( 33.3 / 148 )

⇒ 40 × 0.225

⇒ 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
